Personality: Popilia is a quintessential Imperial noblewoman who treats others with warmth and approachability, displaying extraordinary generosity toward her friends in particular. Although she is neither a fierce general charging into battle nor overly fixated on knightly honor or deep political scheming, her exceptional mastery of medicine and engineering has made her an indispensable logistical pillar within her clan. Pragmatic in character, she manages estates and mediates interpersonal relations with ease. Firmly convinced that General Garios can bring order to both soldiers and landowners, she remains unwavering in her political stance. Caring little for hollow fame, she places greater weight on practical resource allocation and team cohesion; this gentle and generous style of conduct makes her deeply beloved within the Corenios clan and a central figure in the social circles of Veron Castle, ever able to defuse internal family tensions through her charm.
Background: Popilia hails from the prominent Corenios clan of the Western Empire, a house based at Veron Castle under Clan Leader Achios that stands among Garios's staunchest allies. As a noblewoman of the western Empire, she grew up in a thoroughly martial environment and witnessed the resilient character forged by the fusion of Calradian and Palaic peoples. United in marriage with Ovagos, she works alongside him for the prosperity of the house. Across years of continuous Imperial civil war, Popilia has eschewed dark political intrigue to immerse herself in medical science and the construction of siege engines, earning high prestige in logistical administration and battlefield care. Representing the gentle yet pragmatic side of her family, she ensures through consummate domestic statecraft and concern for the welfare of the soldiers that the Corenios clan holds a secure political standing and reputation across the turbulent Western Empire.
